name: Multi-Functional Travel Backpack | Business Daypack with Laptop Compartment | Black & Yellow
description:
Carry your essentials with ease using the Multi-Functional Travel Backpack, designed for both practicality and modern style. It features multiple compartments to neatly store laptops, books, and accessories. Made from durable, water-resistant polyester fabric with reinforced stitching, this backpack is built to last. With padded shoulder straps, breathable back support, and an included rain cover, it’s ideal for office, college, school, travel, and business use.
Key Features
 Spacious capacity with multiple compartments
 Durable & water-resistant polyester with reinforced stitching
 Padded shoulder straps & breathable back support
 Sleek professional design for office, college & travel
 Protective rain cover included
How to Use
 Store laptop, books & essentials in compartments
 Adjust padded straps for comfort
 Use rain cover in wet weather
 Wipe with damp cloth for cleaning
Material
Polyester Fabric, Reinforced Stitching, Zippers
Safety Information
 Do not overload beyond capacity
 Keep away from sharp objects
 Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight
 Use rain cover for water protection
Package Includes
 1 × Multi-Functional Travel Backpack (Black & Yellow)
 1 × Protective Rain Cover
